Name: Aggro
Text: When an enemy attacks, you may intercept in the following ways:

If you have a [b][color=ffaa64]Speed Die[/color][/b], you may add your [b][color=ff8064]Aggro[/color][/b] to the value, if the total is equal to or greater than the opposing [b][color=ffaa64]Speed Die[/color][/b], you may use your [b][color=ffaa64]Speed Die[/color][/b] to intercept.

If the opposing [b][color=ffaa64]Speed Die[/color][/b] is equal to or lower than your [b][color=ff8064]Aggro[/color][/b]. You may intercept without spending a [b][color=ffaa64]Speed Die[/color][/b], but only being able to deploy saved dice in response.
At the end of each scene, halve the Count.
